planets.name: TOI-1806 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1806 with a 15.2-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-1806 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1806. Its orbit and size follow Hord et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
